name: Cast shadow
description: The ground under something that is not on it. This roster is drawn flat to a top-down field where everything touches the floor, so the one cue that a body is above it is the dark it puts below — a Lance's barb is lobbed, and without this it reads as sliding along the ground rather than arcing over it. Authored as a soft ellipse at rx=12 on a 32×20 canvas, which is the number the game scales by; it shrinks and darkens as the thing above it comes down, and that is the whole of the height cue. Deliberately a gradient rather than a flat disc: a hard-edged oval reads as a second object lying on the floor, and this has to read as absence of light. Terrain props bake their own shadow into their art because they never move — this is for the things that do.
